Test Case Title: Destination is a Full Embargo (Absolute) Country
Test Case Description: Verify that when the destination country has ABSOLUTE flag = Y in LCS_ABSOLUTE_EMBARGO table the system returns Embargo decision with EL license
Pre-Conditions: 1. System has CN Export Controls module active. 2. LCS_ABSOLUTE_EMBARGO table contains the destination country with ABSOLUTE = Y
Test Steps: 1. Create an order with China (CN) as origin. 2. Set Country of Ultimate Destination (CUD) to a country with ABSOLUTE flag = Y (e.g., Cuba - CU). 3. Run License Determination. 4. Check the decision and license output.
Test Data (Input): COS=CN, CUD=CU (Cuba - full embargo), ECN=EAR99, ECN.DOS=N
Expected Result: Decision = Embargo; License = EL; Hold = DOC Hold
Remarks: ABSOLUTE flag must be Y in LCS_ABSOLUTE_EMBARGO table per revision history note 2

Test Case Title: Destination is NOT a Full Embargo Country
Test Case Description: Verify that when the destination country has no absolute embargo the system proceeds to the Sanction country check
Pre-Conditions: 1. System has CN Export Controls module active. 2. Destination country is NOT present with ABSOLUTE = Y in LCS_ABSOLUTE_EMBARGO
Test Steps: 1. Create an order with COS = CN. 2. Set CUD to a non-embargo country (e.g., Germany - DE). 3. Run License Determination. 4. Verify system moves to next check (Sanction check).
Test Data (Input): COS=CN, CUD=DE (Germany - no embargo), ECN=EAR99, ECN.DOS=N
Expected Result: System does not return Embargo decision; proceeds to Sanction Country check

Test Case Title: Destination is Sanction Country with Military End Use
Test Case Description: Verify that when destination is a sanction country AND end use is Military the system returns EL (DOC Hold) with Sanctions may apply comment
Pre-Conditions: 1. Destination country has ABSOLUTE = N in LCS_ABSOLUTE_EMBARGO (sanction but not full embargo). 2. Order has military end use flag set
Test Steps: 1. Create an order with COS = CN. 2. Set CUD to a sanction country (ABSOLUTE=N). 3. Set End Use = Military. 4. Run License Determination. 5. Verify license and comments.
Test Data (Input): COS=CN, CUD=SY (Syria - sanction), EndUse=Military, ECN=EAR99, ECN.DOS=N
Expected Result: License = EL; Hold = DOC Hold; Comments include 'Sanctions may apply'
Remarks: Per Ver. 14.5.6 - Military end use triggers DOC Hold even for sanction-only countries

Test Case Title: Destination is Sanction Country with Military Intelligence End Use
Test Case Description: Verify that Military Intelligence end use is treated same as Military for sanction countries - triggers EL DOC Hold with sanctions comment
Pre-Conditions: 1. Destination country has ABSOLUTE = N in LCS_ABSOLUTE_EMBARGO. 2. Order has Military Intelligence end use flag set (added per 08/03/21 revision)
Test Steps: 1. Create an order with COS = CN. 2. Set CUD to a sanction country. 3. Set End Use = Military Intelligence. 4. Run License Determination. 5. Verify license and comments.
Test Data (Input): COS=CN, CUD=SY (Syria - sanction), EndUse=Military Intelligence, ECN=EAR99, ECN.DOS=N
Expected Result: License = EL; Hold = DOC Hold; Comments include 'Sanctions may apply'
Remarks: Military Intelligence check added 08/03/21 per revision history

Test Case Title: Destination is Sanction Country with Non-Military End Use
Test Case Description: Verify that sanction country with non-military end use adds Sanctions may apply comment but continues license determination flow
Pre-Conditions: 1. Destination country has ABSOLUTE = N in LCS_ABSOLUTE_EMBARGO. 2. Order has non-military end use
Test Steps: 1. Create an order with COS = CN. 2. Set CUD to a sanction country. 3. Set End Use = Commercial. 4. Run License Determination. 5. Verify Sanctions comment is added and flow continues to ECN.DOS check.
Test Data (Input): COS=CN, CUD=SY (Syria - sanction), EndUse=Commercial, ECN=EAR99, ECN.DOS=N
Expected Result: Sanctions may apply comment added to decision; flow continues to ECN.DOS check; final result depends on ECN values

Test Case Title: Destination is NOT a Sanction Country
Test Case Description: Verify that non-sanction non-embargo destination proceeds directly to ECN.DOS check without any sanctions comment
Pre-Conditions: 1. Destination country is neither in LCS_ABSOLUTE_EMBARGO with ABSOLUTE=Y nor ABSOLUTE=N
Test Steps: 1. Create an order with COS = CN. 2. Set CUD to a non-sanction country (e.g., Japan - JP). 3. Run License Determination. 4. Verify no sanctions comment is added; flow proceeds to ECN.DOS check.
Test Data (Input): COS=CN, CUD=JP (Japan - no sanction/embargo), EndUse=Commercial, ECN=EAR99, ECN.DOS=N
Expected Result: No Sanctions may apply comment; flow proceeds to ECN.DOS check

Test Case Title: ECN.DOS Flag is Y - Munitions List Item

Test Steps: 1. Create an order with COS = CN. 2. Set CUD = JP (non-sanction). 3. Use an item with ECN.DOS = Y. 4. Run License Determination. 5. Verify license and hold type.

Expected Result: License = EL; Hold = DOS Hold
Remarks: ECN.DOS=Y is set for all items classified under Military Goods List per note 1

Test Case Title: ECN.DOS Flag is N - Not a Munitions List Item
Test Case Description: Verify that when ECN.DOS = N the system proceeds to ECN classification check

Test Steps: 1. Create an order with COS = CN. 2. Set CUD = JP (non-sanction). 3. Use an item with ECN.DOS = N. 4. Run License Determination. 5. Verify system proceeds to ECN check.

Test Case Title: ECN is NULL or Empty

Test Case Title: ECN equals NOCLASS with Different Case (Case Sensitivity)

Test Data (Input): COS=CN, CUD=JP, ECN=noclass (lowercase), ECN.DOS=N

Test Case Title: Line Level CUD Exists - Use Line CUD

Expected Result: CUD = JP (Line Shipto's country code)

Test Case Title: All CUD Fields Missing - Fallback to Header Shipto Country
Test Case Description: Verify that when all CUD-related fields are missing the final fallback for CUD is the Header Shipto country code

Test Steps: 1. Create an order with all CUD-related fields as NULL. 2. Set Header Shipto to a company in AU. 3. Run License Determination. 4. Verify CUD = Header Shipto country.

Test Case Title: Line Int. ID Missing - Fallback to Header Int. Country ID

Expected Result: Shipto = AU (Shipto ID's country code)

Test Case Title: All Shipto Hierarchy Fields Missing - Use Header Shipto Country
Test Case Description: Verify that when all Shipto hierarchy fields are absent the final fallback is the Header Shipto country

Test Case Title: Sanction Country with Military Intelligence End Use - Boundary Test
Test Case Description: Verify that the Military Intelligence check (08/03/21 revision) is correctly integrated and does not affect non-sanction country flows
Pre-Conditions: 1. Destination = NON-sanction country. 2. End Use = Military Intelligence
Test Steps: 1. Create order with COS = CN. 2. Set CUD = JP (non-sanction). 3. Set EndUse = Military Intelligence. 4. Run License Determination. 5. Verify flow is based only on ECN checks NOT sanction-military check.
Test Data (Input): COS=CN, CUD=JP (non-sanction), EndUse=Military Intelligence, ECN=NOCLASS, ECN.DOS=N
Expected Result: Decision = NLR (Military Intelligence check only applies inside Sanction Country branch of flowchart)
Remarks: Military Intelligence check is ONLY triggered when inside the Sanction Country = YES branch

Test Case Title: Embargo Country Added After Go-Live - Verify Real-Time Table Lookup
Test Case Description: Verify that when a new country is added to LCS_ABSOLUTE_EMBARGO the system immediately picks up the new embargo without requiring a system restart or cache refresh
Pre-Conditions: 1. System is live. 2. A new country is being added to LCS_ABSOLUTE_EMBARGO
Test Steps: 1. Process an order for Country X - verify no embargo. 2. Add Country X to LCS_ABSOLUTE_EMBARGO with ABSOLUTE = Y. 3. Process a NEW order for Country X without restarting system. 4. Verify embargo decision is returned.
Test Data (Input): COS=CN, CUD=CountryX (newly embargoed), ECN=NOCLASS, ECN.DOS=N
Expected Result: New order for Country X returns Embargo decision immediately after table update
Remarks: Tests real-time table-driven configuration as per notes 2 and 3

Test Case Title: Sanction Country Removed from LCS_ABSOLUTE_EMBARGO - Verify Real-Time Update
Test Case Description: Verify that when a country is removed from the sanctions list (ABSOLUTE = N record deleted) new orders are processed correctly without sanctions comment
Pre-Conditions: 1. A country currently has ABSOLUTE = N in LCS_ABSOLUTE_EMBARGO. 2. Record is deleted from the table
Test Steps: 1. Confirm sanction order gets sanctions comment for Country Y. 2. Delete Country Y from LCS_ABSOLUTE_EMBARGO. 3. Create new order for Country Y. 4. Verify no sanctions comment and normal ECN processing.
Test Data (Input): COS=CN, CUD=CountryY (sanction removed), ECN=NOCLASS, ECN.DOS=N
Expected Result: Order for Country Y processed normally without sanctions comment after table update
Remarks: Tests that un-sanctioning a country is immediately effective per table-driven design
